title: The detail pane keeps its scroll on a redraw

blocked.reason: The engine's viewport ownership is still a design question.

intent.outcome: The detail pane keeps the line it was on when the document is rebuilt.
intent.problem: The engine's viewport resets when the document is rebuilt, so a redraw jumps to the top of a long task.

in_scope: the rebuild that follows a resize

acceptance_criteria.description: A resize keeps the first visible line, clamped to the new height.
A document shorter than the pane settles at the top.
